product.name: Motoron M3S256 Triple Motor Controller Shield for Arduino (Connectors Soldered)

warnings: No dimensions are printed in the images or text. The PCB is assumed to match the standard Arduino Uno shield footprint of about 68.6 x 53.3 mm. The third image supports this, since the board sits on an Uno-style board and roughly matches its footprint. Z of about 19 mm is an estimate covering the PCB (about 1.6 mm), the tall header bodies, and the pins protruding below. The two mounting holes are visible near the corners of the PCB, but their positions and the 3.2 mm diameter are estimates. Other holes are not listed. The small castellated or test pads are not confirmed as holes, and the header pin patterns are not given as holes. Hole positions are relative to the board center, with z set at the board mid-plane.
Dimensions are unverified; the PCB size is assumed to be the standard Uno footprint.

The boundsMm axes were followed (Y = 53.3, Z = 19), so the PCB lies in the XY plane with its thickness along Z, even though the rules say the bottom sits at Y=0. The bottom of the part is at Y=0 as the PCB edge.
Header placement, pin counts, terminal block positions and sizes, and capacitor positions are approximate.
The mounting hole positions are estimates.
The ICs, LEDs, SMD parts, test pads and silkscreen are omitted.
